message.bingzhengmod.toxic_herb_used: Raw "%s" taken — its toxin strikes the heart vessels!
message.bingzhengmod.decoction_drunk: You drink "%s"; the exterior grows harmonious.
message.bingzhengmod.delirium_merge: The qi assail one another — the spirit is thrown into delirium!
message.bingzhengmod.delirium_start: Delirium strikes: you cannot stop running, hunger gnaws, the spirit quakes.
message.bingzhengmod.delirium_end: The delirium subsides; the heart is not yet at peace.
message.bingzhengmod.meditation_hint: Stand upon the cushion and keep still to enter meditation.
message.bingzhengmod.meditation_session_: A night of seated meditation: %s session(s) accumulated.
message.bingzhengmod.meditation_insomnia: Three consecutive night sessions cancel %s night(s) of insomnia.
command.bingzhengmod.emotion.misc: delirium cooldown %s ticks / meditation nights %s / session %s ticks / delirium active %s
command.bingzhengmod.emotion.cleared: Cleared delirium, disturbances and reset emotions to baseline
command.bingzhengmod.emotion_debug.on: [Emotion debug] console printing ON (one line per 20 ticks); run /bingzhengmod emotion debug again to stop.
command.bingzhengmod.emotion_debug.faile: [Emotion debug] toggle failed: %s (see the game log)
command.bingzhengmod.emotion_debug.decay: [Emotion debug] delirium exit — high emotion decay: %s | coefficient %s
command.bingzhengmod.emotion_debug.line: [Emotion] anger %s joy %s worry %s pensiveness %s grief %s fear %s fright %s
command.bingzhengmod.emotion_debug.rhyth: [Emotion] shichen %s (%s) | wave offsets anger%s joy%s pensiveness%s grief%s fear%s | stable anger%s joy%s pensiveness%s grief%s fear%s | (disturbance and merge read stable values only)
command.bingzhengmod.fatigue.line: [Fatigue] spirit %s (%s cells) | body %s (%s cells) | hunger %s | blocks %s | sprint %s/100 m | swim %s/100 m | night %s t | idle %s t | sleep debt %s | sunlight %s/3000 t | all-nighter last night %s | sleeping %s
command.bingzhengmod.fatigue.note: [Fatigue] sources: hunger -1 -> +2 | 10 blocks +1 | 100 m sprint/swim +1 | GUI +1 (enchanting +2, 10s anti-spam) | night +1/real minute | idle -5/10 real minutes. HUD toggle: config/bingzhengmod-emotion-hud.properties
command.bingzhengmod.fatigue.usage: Fatigue subcommands: (none)=snapshot | set spirit|body <value> | reset=zero spirit and body | debug=toggle periodic printing
command.bingzhengmod.fatigue.reset: [Fatigue] spirit and body consumption reset to 0
command.bingzhengmod.fatigue_debug.on: [Fatigue debug] periodic printing ON (one line per 20 ticks); run /bingzhengmod fatigue debug again to stop.
command.bingzhengmod.wuzang.shichen: Shichen: %s (%s in season) | stable values shown here; see wuzang debug for the fluctuating ones
command.bingzhengmod.wuzang_debug.rhythm: [Five Zang] shichen %s (%s) | wave offsets liver%s heart%s spleen%s lung%s kidney%s | stable qi liver%s heart%s spleen%s lung%s kidney%s | judgement and buffs use stable values only
command.bingzhengmod.wuzang.cleared: Five-zang qi and blood reset to the healthy baseline
command.bingzhengmod.wuzang.unknown_part: Second argument must be qi or blood
command.bingzhengmod.wuzang_debug.on: [Five Zang debug] console printing ON (one line per 20 ticks); run /bingzhengmod wuzang debug again to stop.
command.bingzhengmod.wuzang_debug.failed: [Five Zang debug] toggle failed: %s (see the game log)
command.bingzhengmod.wuzang_debug.line: [Five Zang] L%s/%s H%s/%s Sp%s/%s Lu%s/%s K%s/%s
command.bingzhengmod.emotion.usage: Emotion subcommands: (none)=query | set <key> <value> | add <key> <delta> | clear | debug=toggle printing. Keys: anger, joy, worry, pensiveness, grief, fear, fright; spirit/body live under the fatigue group
command.bingzhengmod.wuzang.usage: Five-zang subcommands: (none)=query | set <zang> <qi|blood> <value> | add <zang> <qi|blood> <delta> | clear | debug=toggle printing. Zangs: liver, heart, spleen, lung, kidney
